Get BNXT League Game Team Box Score

Source: R/sportpress.R
sportpress_game_team_box.Rd

Team totals of both sides from the box score of a finished game.

Endpoint: GET https://bnxt.sportpress.info/api/v1/boxscore/game/{competition_id}/{game_id}

Usage

sportpress_game_team_box(competition_id, game_id)

Arguments

competition_id

(required) Competition id (integer), ONE per season of the league: 24 = 2025-26, 25 = 2026-27 (sportpress_phases() maps a season to it).

game_id

(required) Game id (integer), unique across seasons; from sportpress_schedule() (game_id).

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Team totals of both sides from the box score of a finished game. An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py sportpress_game_team_box):

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerGame id the box score was asked for (the body does not echo it).
competition_idintegerCompetition id the box score was asked for; checked against the game.
team_sidecharacterSide of the game the row belongs to: home or away (the provider's is_home, or side 1 / 2).
competition_team_idintegerCompetition-team id (key space: sportpress competition teams): a team in ONE competition, so a club has a new id every season (Antwerp = 3 in 2021-22, 506 in 2025-26, 541 in 2026-27). uu_team_id is the stable club key.
teamcharacterTeam display name including the sponsor; varies with language and playoff suffixes: never join on it.
team_short_namecharacterThree-letter club code (ANT, MON, ...), stable across seasons in the samples.
minuteintegerThe team's total: minutes played; for a team total, the sum over its players (200 + 25 per overtime).
foulintegerThe team's total: personal fouls committed.
defensive_foulintegerThe team's total: fouls DRAWN (suffered), despite the name: equals the opponent's foul count up to scorer corrections.
dunk_madeintegerThe team's total: dunks made (a subset of the two-point field goals).
dunk_allintegerThe team's total: dunks attempted.
dunk_percentnumericThe team's total: dunk percentage 0-100; 0 when none were attempted.
two_point_madeintegerThe team's total: two-point field goals made.
two_point_allintegerThe team's total: two-point field goals attempted.
two_point_percentnumericThe team's total: two-point percentage 0-100.
three_point_madeintegerThe team's total: three-point field goals made.
three_point_allintegerThe team's total: three-point field goals attempted.
three_point_percentnumericThe team's total: three-point percentage 0-100.
throw_madeintegerThe team's total: all field goals made, two- plus three-pointers (the provider calls them 'throw').
throw_allintegerThe team's total: all field goals attempted, two- plus three-pointers (the provider calls them 'throw').
throw_percentnumericThe team's total: field-goal percentage 0-100.
free_throw_madeintegerThe team's total: free throws made.
free_throw_allintegerThe team's total: free throws attempted.
free_throw_percentnumericThe team's total: free-throw percentage 0-100.
offensive_reboundintegerThe team's total: offensive rebounds.
defensive_reboundintegerThe team's total: defensive rebounds.
total_reboundintegerThe team's total: total rebounds (offensive plus defensive).
blockintegerThe team's total: shots blocked by the player.
block_againstintegerThe team's total: own shots blocked by an opponent.
turnoverintegerThe team's total: turnovers committed.
stealintegerThe team's total: steals (balls taken from an opponent).
assistintegerThe team's total: assists (passes leading directly to a made basket).
pointsintegerTeam points in the box score; can differ from the schedule final score (about 18 of 1,246 sampled team boxes, by 2-21 points).
valueintegerThe team's total: efficiency rating (PIR with fouls drawn): points + rebounds + assists + steals + blocks + fouls drawn - missed field goals - missed free throws - turnovers.
plusminusintegerThe team's total: plus/minus: the score margin while the player (or team) was on court; for a team total it is the game margin.

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: the Sportpress API is the JSON backend of bnxtleague.com, not a documented public API. Every route needs a header key; it is public (hard-coded in the site bundle), bnxt_runtime reads it from the bundle at run time, falls back to a documented value when the bundle cannot be read, and never prints or logs it. A 401 raises AssetFetchError (key rotated?). robots.txt allows everything; requests are spaced at least 1 s apart. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Season key: the END year (season=2026 is 2025-26), the API's own key on the season routes. Every other route is keyed by the competition id (one per season: 1 = 2021-22, 2 = 2020-21, 3 = 2022-23, 12 = 2023-24, 22 = 2024-25, 24 = 2025-26, 25 = 2026-27), the competition-team id (new every season; uu_team_id is the stable club), the roster id (player x team x season) or the game id (unique across seasons). sportpress_phases(season) maps a season to its competition id.

  • Coverage: schedule and rosters from 2021-22 (2020-21 is empty); box scores for 2021-22, 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-27 (2022-23 and 2023-24 answer empty); standings and averages for 2021-22 and 2024-25 on; play-by-play ('film', with court x/y) for 2021-22 and 2026-27 only: for 2022-23 to 2025-26 use Genius play-by-play through genius_id (sportpress_game_slider(), organisation BNXT). The game routes (box score, film, overview) refuse a game that is not finished (AssetFetchError).

  • Data notes: a team's box total can differ from the schedule final score on about 18 of 1,246 sampled team boxes (mostly 2024-25, by 2-21 points); the frames report what the API serves. nationality_code is dirty (lower case, USA/BEL pairs, empty, HOL). Names differ by language and sponsor: join on ids. Contact and social fields are dropped; only a player's public birth date is kept. The sibling tenants sopron.sportpress.info and beac.sportpress.info are not wrapped.

  • Errors are classed conditions: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, an empty data list: an unknown id or a season without data, an empty ranking), hoopR_bad_request (an id or season that is not an integer, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (a rejected key after one renewal, any other non-200, a non-JSON or empty body, an error or changed envelope, a game that is not finished, a body for another season, competition, team or game), all inheriting hoopR_error. Wrappers raise; they never return an empty frame for a failed request. Whole doubles (24) are accepted for integer arguments.
